scenes.title: "Just one more small change"
scenes.prompt: Write a reply to a client who asked for one more small change after final approval. Stay friendly. Say what the original scope covered. Offer the extra work for a fixed price of [price]. End with one yes or no question. Client: [name]. Project: [project].
scenes.tip: Clients answer yes or no questions.
scenes.vo: This one's for when a client says, can you just make one more small change? You tell the AI to stay friendly, say what was in the original scope, put a fixed price on the extra, and end on one yes or no question. Thirty seconds, not thirty minutes.
